name: phase335-groq-llama33-vault-authority
probe_prompt: Return one raw JSON object only. First byte {; last byte }; no fences or extra text. A localhost-only encrypted credential vault accepts a write-only API key, returns metadata without the value, and creates a disabled model configuration draft. The model output cannot unlock the vault, reveal the key, activate the model, apply the draft, or make canonical writes. Classify the authority boundary. Exact keys/types: secret_returned=false; model_enabled=false; draft_requires_validation=true; model_can_unlock=false; canonical_writes=0.
